# openmetadata_role (Data Source)

Fetches an OpenMetadata Role by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_role" "data_steward" {
  name = "DataSteward"
}

output "role_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_role.data_steward.id
}

output "role_policies" {
  value = data.openmetadata_role.data_steward.policies
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the role to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the role.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name.
- `domains` (List of String) Fully qualified names of domains this role belongs to.
- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name of the role.
- `id` (String) UUID of the role.
- `policies` (List of String) Fully qualified names of policies attached to this role.
